lines.text_source: Yes, yes, the Human newcomers. Enjoy your stay and everything, or do whatever you want, but don't talk to me.
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.intent: welcome with exaggerated relief and dismissal
lines.base_translation: Sim, sim, os novos Humanos! Aproveitem a estadia e tudo mais, ou façam o que quiserem, mas não venham falar comigo.
